question: 9 月各渠道的 GMV 和订单数
gold: SELECT c.channel_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = o.channel_id WHERE o.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY c.channel_name

question: 列出 9 月各区域的 GMV 和订单数
gold: SELECT r.region_name, SUM(o.pay_amount) AS gmv, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM fact_orders o JOIN dim_region r ON r.region_id = o.region_id WHERE o.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY r.region_name

question: 9 月信息流广告每天的访客数
gold: SELECT t.dt, SUM(t.uv) FROM fact_traffic_daily t JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = t.channel_id WHERE c.channel_name = '信息流广告' AND t.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY t.dt

question: 9 月家电类目 GMV 最高的 5 个商品
gold: SELECT p.product_name, SUM(i.pay_amount) AS gmv FROM fact_order_items i JOIN fact_orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN dim_category c ON c.category_id = p.category_id WHERE c.category_name = '家电' AND o.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY p.product_name ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 5

question: 8 月和 9 月的支付转化率分别是多少
gold: WITH t AS (SELECT substr(dt, 1, 7) AS m, SUM(uv) AS uv FROM fact_traffic_daily WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY m), o AS (SELECT substr(dt, 1, 7) AS m, COUNT(*) AS n FROM fact_orders WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY m) SELECT t.m, o.n * 1.0 / t.uv FROM t JOIN o ON o.m = t.m

question: 9 月新客订单占比是多少
gold: SELECT SUM(is_new_user) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM fact_orders WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'

question: 9 月各渠道的营收和佣金分别是多少
gold: SELECT c.channel_name, s.rev, COALESCE(cm.comm, 0) FROM dim_channel c JOIN (SELECT channel_id, SUM(net_revenue) AS rev FROM fact_sales_daily WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY channel_id) s ON s.channel_id = c.channel_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT channel_id, SUM(commission_amount) AS comm FROM fact_commission_monthly WHERE month = '2026-09' GROUP BY channel_id) cm ON cm.channel_id = c.channel_id

question: 9 月各产品线的营收和毛利率
gold: SELECT d.product_line, SUM(s.net_revenue) AS rev, 1 - SUM(s.sales_qty * c.unit_cogs) / SUM(s.net_revenue) AS gm FROM fact_sales_daily s JOIN dim_sku d ON d.sku_id = s.sku_id JOIN fact_sku_cost_monthly c ON c.sku_id = s.sku_id AND c.month = substr(s.dt, 1, 7) WHERE s.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY d.product_line

question: 6 月到 9 月每个月的净利率
gold: WITH r AS (SELECT substr(s.dt, 1, 7) AS m, SUM(s.net_revenue) AS rev, SUM(s.sales_qty * c.unit_cogs) AS cogs FROM fact_sales_daily s JOIN fact_sku_cost_monthly c ON c.sku_id = s.sku_id AND c.month = substr(s.dt, 1, 7) WHERE s.dt BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY m), l AS (SELECT substr(dt, 1, 7) AS m, SUM(logistics_cost) AS logi FROM fact_logistics_daily WHERE dt BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-09-30' GROUP BY m), cm AS (SELECT month AS m, SUM(commission_amount) AS comm FROM fact_commission_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN '2026-06' AND '2026-09' GROUP BY month), mk AS (SELECT month AS m, SUM(amount) AS mkt FROM fact_marketing_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN '2026-06' AND '2026-09' GROUP BY month) SELECT r.m, (r.rev - r.cogs - l.logi - cm.comm - mk.mkt) / r.rev FROM r JOIN l ON l.m = r.m JOIN cm ON cm.m = r.m JOIN mk ON mk.m = r.m

question: 9 月社区团购渠道的折扣率
gold: SELECT SUM(s.discount_amount) / SUM(s.gross_amount) FROM fact_sales_daily s JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = s.channel_id WHERE c.channel_name = '社区团购' AND s.dt BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
